{-# LANGUAGE GHC2024, CPP, OverloadedRecordDot, OverloadedStrings, DuplicateRecordFields, LambdaCase #-}
module Main where

import Control.Exception (finally)
import Control.Monad (forM_, unless, when)
import Data.Aeson
import Data.Aeson.Types (parseEither)
import Data.IORef
import Data.List (find)
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe, listToMaybe)
import Data.Set qualified as Set
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.Text qualified as T
import Data.Text.Encoding qualified as TE
import Data.ByteString qualified as BS
import Effectful
import Effectful.Concurrent.Async (runConcurrent)
import Effectful.Log (runLog)
import GHC.Clock (getMonotonicTimeNSec)
import Log (LogLevel (LogAttention))
import Max.Agent.Execution
import Max.AgentEvent
import Max.Config (AppConfig (..), loadConfig)
import Max.Effects.Agent
import Max.Effects.LLM
import Max.Effects.Tools
import Max.Effects.ToolControl (ToolControl)
import Max.Effects.ToolOutput (ToolOutput)
import Max.HttpRuntime (newHttpRuntime)
import Max.Log (ColorMode (ColorNever), withCompactLogger)
import Max.ModelCatalog (defaultModelName)
import Max.Platform.Types
import Max.Prompt.System (systemPrompt)
import Max.Task.Policy (frontendToolLimit)
import Max.Tasks
import Max.ToolContext
import Max.Turn.Types
import OneBot.Types
import System.Environment (getArgs, getEnvironment, unsetEnv, withArgs)
import System.Timeout (timeout)
import FrontendContract (frontendContract)
#ifdef OLD
import Max.Effects.TaskControl (TaskControl)
import Max.Effects.TaskExecution (TaskExecution)
import Max.Effects.TaskQuery (TaskQuery)
import Max.Effects.TurnQuery (TurnQuery)
import Max.Effects.ToolControl (finishExecution)
import Max.Tools.Task (taskToolsFor)
#endif

scenario :: String -> Text
scenario = \case
  "explain" -> "用三个自然段解释为什么把最终答复放在工具调用参数里会延迟流式显示。每段两三句，总共大约三百字。不要调用查询工具。"
  "clarify" -> "帮我把那个文件转成 PDF。"
  "lookup" -> "请查随附的虚构发布记录快照，告诉我 Aurora 项目最新版本、发布日期，以及与前一版相比的两项变化；不要凭记忆回答。"
  _ -> error "unknown scenario"

fixture :: Value
fixture = object
  [ "project" .= ("Aurora" :: Text)
  , "version" .= ("2.7.4" :: Text)
  , "released_at" .= ("2026-09-18" :: Text)
  , "previous_version" .= ("2.7.3" :: Text)
  , "changes" .= (["取消当前工作后立即停止发送后续段落","修复重复提醒"] :: [Text])
  , "source" .= ("frozen synthetic release fixture; not the Max repository" :: Text)
  ]

definition :: Text -> ToolDefinition
definition name = ToolDefinition (ToolRef name) (SchemaVersion 1)
  (Set.singleton (EffectRead "fixture")) ParallelSafe RetrySafe
  (Set.singleton CurrentConversation) (ToolDeadline 30) True WorkCall

fixtureTool :: Tool es
fixtureTool = legacyTool "read_fixture" "读取随附的虚构 Aurora 发布记录快照。只读，不访问外部系统。"
  (object ["type" .= ("object" :: Text), "properties" .= object [], "additionalProperties" .= False])
  (const (pure (Right fixture)))

#ifdef OLD
finishTool :: (ToolControl :> es, IOE :> es) => ToolContext -> IORef [Value] -> Tool es
finishTool context reports =
  let original = fromMaybe (error "missing baseline finish tool") $
        find ((== "request_finish") . (.toolName))
          (taskToolsFor context :: [Tool '[ToolControl, TaskQuery, TaskControl, TaskExecution, TurnQuery]])
   in Tool original.toolName original.toolDescription original.toolSchema $ OutcomeRunner $ \args ->
        case parseEither (withObject "finish" (\fields -> (,) <$> fields .: "disposition" <*> fields .: "reply")) args of
          Left err -> pure (ToolRejected (ToolFault "invalid_finish" (T.pack err) RetrySafe))
          Right (disposition :: Text, reply :: Text) -> do
            liftIO (modifyIORef' reports (<> [args]))
            finishExecution (Just (T.strip reply))
            pure (ToolCommitted (object ["returned" .= True, "reply" .= T.strip reply, "disposition" .= disposition]))
#endif

main :: IO ()
main = do
  [configPath, scenarioName, resultPath, revision] <- getArgs
  getEnvironment >>= mapM_ (\(name, _) -> when (T.isPrefixOf "MAX_LLM_" (T.pack name)) (unsetEnv name))
  cfg <- withArgs ["--config-file", configPath] loadConfig
  calls <- newIORef []
  events <- newIORef ([] :: [(Double, Text, Text)])
  reports <- newIORef ([] :: [Value])
  errors <- newIORef ([] :: [Text])
  names <- newIORef ([] :: [Text])
  registry <- newTaskRegistry
  let ref = AgentTurnRef (AgentTurnId 1) (TurnOrdinal 1)
#ifdef OLD
  turn <- beginDurableTurnRuntime registry ref (GroupId 7777) (UserId 2001) (Just (CanonicalMessageId 7413))
#else
  turn <- beginTurnRuntime registry ref (GroupId 7777) (UserId 2001) (Just (CanonicalMessageId 7413))
#endif
  let context = mkToolContext
        (TurnIdentity (GroupId 7777) (CanonicalMessageId 7413) (UserId 2001) (UserId 1000) (PrincipalId 2001) Nothing Nothing)
        (TurnCapabilities False False False qqAdvertisedCaps False Map.empty Nothing False)
      agentContext = AgentContext context Nothing (Just frontendToolLimit)
      system = systemPrompt False False qqAdvertisedCaps cfg.persona [] <> frontendContract
      messages = [MsgSystem system, MsgUser ("[current message]\n[12:00 Tester #7413]: " <> scenario scenarioName)]
#ifdef OLD
      tools = [fixtureTool, finishTool context reports]
      definitions = [definition "read_fixture",
        (definition "request_finish") {tdSchemaVersion = SchemaVersion 2, tdEffects = Set.singleton (EffectWrite "task.db"), tdParallelism = SequentialOnly, tdRetryClass = RetryUnsafe, tdFailuresPrecedeEffects = False, tdCallMode = FinishCall}]
      admission = ExecutionAdmission (const (pure True)) (const (pure True)) (\_ _ _ _ -> pure Nothing)
      journal = ExecutionJournal (\_ _ -> pure ()) (\_ _ -> pure ()) (\_ _ -> pure ()) (const (pure [])) (const (pure "")) (\_ _ _ _ -> pure ())
#else
      tools = [fixtureTool]
      definitions = [definition "read_fixture"]
      admission = ExecutionAdmission (const (pure True)) (const (pure True)) (\_ _ -> pure True)
      journal = ExecutionJournal (\_ _ _ -> pure ()) (const pure) (\_ _ -> pure ())
#endif
  runtime <- newHttpRuntime
  started <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  let elapsed = (\now -> fromIntegral (now - started) / 1e6 :: Double) <$> getMonotonicTimeNSec
      visible kind body = unless (T.null (T.strip body)) $ do
        ms <- elapsed
        modifyIORef' events (<> [(ms, kind, body)])
      sink :: (IOE :> es) => AgentEventSink (Eff es)
      sink = \case
        AgentProgressText body -> liftIO (visible "progress" body)
        AgentFinalStreamText body -> True <$ liftIO (visible "stream" body)
        AgentToolDebug (ToolCallsStarted requests) -> liftIO (modifyIORef' names (<> map fst requests))
        AgentToolDebug (ToolCallFinished name outcome) -> case outcome of
          Left err -> liftIO (modifyIORef' errors (<> [name <> ": " <> err]))
          Right _ -> pure ()
  result <- finally
    (timeout 240000000 $
      withCompactLogger ColorNever Nothing $ \logger ->
        runEff . runConcurrent . runLog "simplification-eval" logger LogAttention
          . runLLM runtime (\_ _ _ -> pure ()) (\call -> modifyIORef' calls (<> [call])) cfg.llm
          . runAgentWith admission journal (ExecutionInbox (const (pure ""))) Nothing (AgentLimits 4) (const (buildToolRegistry definitions tools)) $
          agentTurn turn agentContext (defaultModelName cfg.llm) messages sink)
    (finishTurnRuntime registry turn)
  forM_ result $ \value -> visible "final_tail" (T.drop (T.length value.sentPrefix) (fromMaybe "" value.reply))
  duration <- elapsed
  seen <- readIORef calls
  emitted <- readIORef events
  finishReports <- readIORef reports
  toolNames <- readIORef names
  toolErrors <- readIORef errors
  let callRecord call = object
        [ "model" .= call.crModel, "profile" .= call.crProfile, "streamed" .= call.crStreamed
        , "duration_ms" .= call.crDurationMs, "request" .= call.crRequest, "response" .= call.crResponse
        , "error" .= call.crError
        , "usage" .= fmap (\u -> object ["prompt" .= u.usagePrompt, "completion" .= u.usageCompletion, "cached" .= u.usageCachedPrompt]) call.crUsage]
  encodeFile resultPath $ object
    [ "revision" .= revision, "scenario" .= scenarioName, "profile" .= defaultModelName cfg.llm
    , "system_utf8_bytes" .= BS.length (TE.encodeUtf8 system)
    , "duration_ms" .= duration
    , "first_output_boundary_ms" .= fmap (\(t,_,_) -> t) (listToMaybe emitted)
    , "events" .= [object ["ms" .= t, "kind" .= kind, "text" .= body] | (t,kind,body) <- emitted]
    , "timed_out" .= maybe True (const False) result
    , "reply" .= (result >>= (.reply)), "aborted" .= fmap (fmap (T.pack . show) . (.aborted)) result
    , "calls" .= map callRecord seen, "tool_names" .= toolNames, "tool_errors" .= toolErrors
    , "finish_reports" .= finishReports
    , "limits" .= ("Isolated model-loop comparison: synthetic messages and read tool; no database, real tools or platform send. Timings stop at the Agent output boundary, not QQ receipt. Ambient production load is uncontrolled." :: Text)
    ]
  print (scenarioName, length seen, duration, map (\(_,kind,_) -> kind) emitted)

events.text:
把最终答复放在工具调用参数里时，前台首先要把这次工具调用完整编码、发送给工具，再等待工具返回结果。对用户可见的正文通常要等这一步结束后，系统才知道该显示什么，因此文字不会像普通回复那样边生成边送出。

流式显示依赖的是一段段已经确定、可以直接推给前端的输出，而工具参数属于待执行请求的一部分，往往会先被缓冲、校验和序列化。哪怕参数里已经塞满了最终文字，前端也可能把它当作内部调用数据处理，不会提前拆成聊天消息渲染。

如果工具执行时间较长，延迟就会叠加在整段答复之前；工具失败或参数校验不通过时，用户甚至看不到那段文字。更合适的做法是先用工具完成必要操作，拿到结果后再把最终答复作为独立正文输出，这样才有机会正常流式显示。

events.text: [reply#7413] 因为工具调用参数属于发给工具的结构化请求，不是发给用户的正文。模型一旦决定调用工具，前端通常会先等待这段请求完成，再把工具状态交给渲染器；参数里的文字就算已经生成，也只是“塞进信封”，不会按普通答复流出来。
流式显示依赖的是 assistant 正文增量，前端收到一小段就能立刻绘制一小段。若把最终答案写在参数中，模型往往还要等参数闭合、工具执行完，甚至等后续结果返回后才能继续输出正文，于是用户看到的就是一段空白等待，而不是逐字出现。
另外，工具参数还可能被系统截断、隐藏或按 JSON 缓冲解析，长文本放进去会增加转义和校验成本。
正确做法是参数里只放工具真正需要的输入，工具结束后再把最终答复直接写入 assistant 正文，这样才不会把显示链路堵在工具调用上。

events.text: [reply#7413] 因为工具调用通常要先把完整的调用消息组装好，再交给工具执行；参数里的文字会被当成“要传给工具的数据”，而不是当前对话可以直接发送给你的正文。模型在这一步往往还没提交可展示的答复片段，所以前端只能等调用请求成形，表现出来就是开头卡住了。
而且工具调用一般还要经过序列化、传输、执行和返回结果几个环节。即使参数里已经写了最终答案，客户端也不会把它提前当作聊天内容渲染，得等工具链结束后，模型重新收到结果，再生成一条真正的 assistant 消息，延迟就被硬生生叠起来了。
把正文直接放在正常回复通道里，模型就能边生成边发送，前端也能按片段逐步显示；需要工具时，只把必要的查询参数交给工具，工具返回后再补充结论。
否则就像把信写在快递单备注里，快递没送到之前，收件人当然看不见，挺合理但也挺磨人。

events.text:
把最终答复放进工具调用参数时，它首先会被协议识别为一次结构化调用，而不是普通的助手文本。前端通常只把正在生成的文本块直接渲染出来，工具参数则要等调用消息组装完成后，才会作为完整数据发送。

在工具真正执行前，系统还可能等待参数解析、校验和路由；执行结束后，又要接收工具返回结果，才能决定如何结束这轮交互。于是参数里的文字会被困在中间流程中，无法像正文那样边生成边展示，用户看到的就是一段空白或明显停顿。

这也是流式输出和工具调用之间的边界：流式正文走展示通道，工具参数走控制通道，后者优先保证结构完整而不是逐字显示。若想让用户及时看到内容，就应先用普通消息播报进度，最终答复再通过专门的结束工具提交；否则就只能等整个调用链完成后一次性出现。
